notes: Petition 1617 (Lickinfrogs): the Froglok Herbalist's protection event, EQOA-Data's Good Tank Episode 1 and questmasters t238: every 5 minutes two froglok come for the herbalist (watchmen dark blue, guardsmen white, a lookout yellow and a scout red), three rounds, then two red bouncers; the step is done for the players near who hold the ingredients when the brew is done (the guide's 'the popups have an Area of Effect'); the herbalist's death fails it, nothing taken. Levels for a 60, templates, the spawn point and the potion from the herbalist himself (no Guk (S) human in the data) are ours.

templates.name: guk bouncer
templates.note: The Froglok Herbalist's bouncers (petition 1617): 'they con red and are very difficult. They are NOT to be underestimated' (Good Tank Ep1). Figures ours: a group's two red L64s, 2.6x a roamer's hit points, 1.9x its melee, a 1,000 crit.

steps.text: The froglok herbalist falls, and his brew spills into the muck. Your ingredients are still yours: bring them to him again when he is back.
Now guard me while I brew! The Guk's own will come for me, two at a time, for the better part of an hour. Do not let them reach me.
